extraction.notes: IRT reports no AFFO; CFFO is the adjusted FFO metric, so affo fields are null. Source is the three-months-ended-June-30-2024 column on printed page 14. Net income of 10,555 is before NCI allocation; the FFO section starts there. Check: 10,555 + 53,757 + 598 + 336 = 65,246; 65,246 + 370 + 465 - 2,283 - 184 + 0 + 0 = 63,614. Shares: 230,734,872 weighted average shares and OP units, shown as 230,734.872 thousand; 65,246 / 230,734.872 = 0.28, matching reported FFO per share. The impairment line is a net amount (a 152 loss on impairment plus a 184 prepayment gain netted out); I classed it as re_impairment. The prepayment line on dispositions was classed as debt_extinguishment because it is a prepayment penalty/gain on debt. Recurring capex of $8.3 million is printed in millions, so 8,300 is rounded to the nearest $0.1 million. It is from the Capital Expenditures paragraph on printed page 3 (seq 5), quarterly, total portfolio.
